content.value: Idioms are figurative expressions whose meanings cannot be deduced literally from individual words.
परीक्षा टिप्स: सेतु श्रृंखला के मुख्य सूत्रों और बिंदुओं को बार-बार दोहराएं।

mcqs.question: What is the meaning of: A blessing in disguise?
options: A good thing that seemed bad at first
mcqs.explanation: A positive outcome that initially seemed unfortunate.
